figure.caption: Digital subtraction angiography, sagittal plane. Red arrow: superficial middle cerebral vein. Green arrow: superior anastomotic vein (Trolard’s vein). Blue arrow: inferior anastomotic vein (Labbé’s vein).
figure.visualReview: One whole-head lateral angiographic panel. Red, green and blue arrows are visibly retained at the three caption-identified cortical venous pathways. No right/left patient-side marker is specified in the caption or visible image.
figure.inferenceLimit: Do not infer the depicted hemisphere from the right-sided BodyParts3D models. The image has its own source and unspecified patient side.

otherSourceInspection: Sadik article captions contain no other figure specifically labelling both Trolard and Labbé. Figure 3 is DSA. MRV/CTV counterparts were not acquired.
